quests.instruction: What is the action word for moving behind someone as they go somewhere?
quests.question: Follow
quests.hint: Think about walking right behind your teacher in a line.
quests.explanation: Follow means to move behind someone as they go. We follow our teacher in a line!
quests.funFact: Baby ducks follow their mother wherever she goes!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for putting yourself somewhere so no one can see you?
quests.question: Hide
quests.hint: Think about what you do behind a tree during a fun game.
quests.explanation: Hide means to put yourself where no one can see you. We hide during a game of hide-and-seek!
quests.funFact: Hide-and-seek is a favorite game for children all around the world!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for giving part of what you have to someone else?
quests.question: Share
quests.hint: Think about splitting your snack with a friend.
quests.explanation: Share means to give part of what you have to someone else. We share our toys and snacks!
quests.funFact: Sharing with friends is a wonderful way to show kindness!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for doing something useful for another person?
quests.question: Help
quests.hint: Think about what you do when a friend drops their books.
quests.explanation: Help means to do something useful for someone else. We help our friends and family!
quests.funFact: Helping someone can make both people feel happy inside!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for putting pieces together to make something?
quests.question: Build
quests.hint: Think about what you do with blocks to make a tower.
quests.explanation: Build means to put pieces together to make something new. We build towers with blocks!
quests.funFact: Builders use plans to help them build strong, safe buildings!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for placing things neatly one on top of another?
quests.question: Stack
quests.hint: Think about what you do with blocks to make them tall.
quests.explanation: Stack means to place things one on top of another. We stack blocks to build a tower!
quests.funFact: A tall stack needs a wide, steady bottom so it does not fall!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for using a sticky liquid to join things together?
quests.question: Glue
quests.hint: Think about what you use to make paper stick to paper.
quests.explanation: Glue means to use a sticky liquid to join things together. We glue paper for our crafts!
quests.funFact: Glue was even used by people thousands of years ago to fix broken pots!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for filling a picture with crayons or markers?
quests.question: Color
quests.hint: Think about what you do inside the lines of a coloring book.
quests.explanation: Color means to fill a picture with crayons or markers. We color pictures at school!
quests.funFact: Coloring inside the lines takes careful control of your hand!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for copying a shape by following its outline with a pencil?
quests.question: Trace
quests.hint: Think about following dotted lines to copy a letter shape.
quests.explanation: Trace means to copy a shape by following its outline. We trace letters to learn to write!
quests.funFact: Tracing letters helps your hand learn the right shape to write!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for rubbing something out so it disappears from paper?
quests.question: Erase
quests.hint: Think about what you do with the pink end of a pencil.
quests.explanation: Erase means to rub something out so it disappears. We erase mistakes with an eraser!
quests.funFact: Erasers were invented to help fix little mistakes on paper!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for putting things into groups that belong together?
quests.question: Sort
quests.hint: Think about putting red blocks with red blocks and blue with blue.
quests.explanation: Sort means to put things into groups that belong together. We sort toys by color or size!
quests.funFact: Sorting things into groups helps you find them again quickly!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for saying numbers in order to find out how many there are?
quests.question: Count
quests.hint: Think about saying one, two, three while pointing at your toys.
quests.explanation: Count means to say numbers in order to find out how many. We count our toys and steps!
quests.funFact: Counting helps you know exactly how many things you have!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for gathering things together over time?
quests.question: Collect
quests.hint: Think about picking up pretty shells at the beach.
quests.explanation: Collect means to gather things together. We collect shells, stickers, or rocks that we love!
quests.funFact: Many people enjoy collecting things like stamps, coins, or stickers!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for giving a plant a drink to help it grow?
quests.question: Water
quests.hint: Think about what you do with a small can to help a flower grow.
quests.explanation: Water means to give a plant a drink to help it grow. We water our plants every day!
quests.funFact: Plants need water, sunlight, and air to grow big and healthy!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for putting a seed into the soil to grow?
quests.question: Plant
quests.hint: Think about what a gardener does with a small seed and some dirt.
quests.explanation: Plant means to put a seed into the soil so it can grow. We plant seeds in spring!
quests.funFact: A tiny seed can grow into a huge plant with time and care!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for making a hole in the ground with a shovel or your hands?
quests.question: Dig
quests.hint: Think about what you do at the beach to make a big hole in the sand.
quests.explanation: Dig means to make a hole in the ground. We dig in the sand or the garden!
quests.funFact: Some animals, like rabbits, dig deep tunnels called burrows!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for using a long tool to gather leaves together?
quests.question: Rake
quests.hint: Think about using a tool with long teeth to pile up leaves.
quests.explanation: Rake means to use a long tool to gather leaves or grass. We rake leaves in autumn!
quests.funFact: Raking leaves into a big pile is a fun way to help in fall!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for giving food to an animal or a person?
quests.question: Feed
quests.hint: Think about what you do to help a hungry pet.
quests.explanation: Feed means to give food to someone or something. We feed our pets every day!
quests.funFact: Many animals depend on people to feed them if they live in a home!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for gently stroking an animal with your hand?
quests.question: Pet
quests.hint: Think about softly rubbing a cat or dog's soft fur.
quests.explanation: Pet means to gently stroke an animal. We pet a dog to show it kindness!
quests.funFact: Gently petting an animal can help both you and the animal feel calm!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for gliding smoothly on wheels or blades?
quests.question: Skate
quests.hint: Think about gliding across ice on special shoes with blades.
quests.explanation: Skate means to glide smoothly on wheels or blades. We skate at the ice rink!
quests.funFact: Ice skates have a thin blade that glides smoothly over the ice!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for moving smoothly down a slippery surface?
quests.question: Slide
quests.hint: Think about going down the curvy part of a playground.
quests.explanation: Slide means to move smoothly down a slippery surface. We slide down the playground slide!
quests.funFact: A playground slide is built at just the right angle for a fun, safe ride!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for staying steady without falling over?
quests.question: Balance
quests.hint: Think about walking carefully along a low beam without tipping over.
quests.explanation: Balance means to stay steady without falling. We balance on one foot during a game!
quests.funFact: Your ears help your body know how to balance without falling over!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for competing to see who can move the fastest?
quests.question: Race
quests.hint: Think about lining up with friends to see who reaches the tree first.
quests.explanation: Race means to compete to see who is fastest. We race our friends to the fence!
quests.funFact: In a race, everyone tries their best, and that is what matters most!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for shouting happily to support someone?
quests.question: Cheer
quests.hint: Think about what a crowd does when their team scores a goal.
quests.explanation: Cheer means to shout happily to support someone. We cheer for our team at a game!
quests.funFact: Cheering loudly can help players feel excited and encouraged!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for making a place tidy and free of mess?
quests.question: Clean
quests.hint: Think about what you do to your room before your friends visit.
quests.explanation: Clean means to make a place tidy and free of mess. We clean our room every week!
quests.funFact: A clean room can help you find your favorite toys much faster!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for rubbing a cloth over something to clean it?
quests.question: Wipe
quests.hint: Think about what you do with a napkin after a messy snack.
quests.explanation: Wipe means to rub a cloth over something to clean it. We wipe the table after we eat!
quests.funFact: Wiping up small spills quickly keeps the floor safe and dry!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for washing something with clean running water?
quests.question: Rinse
quests.hint: Think about what you do to a cup under the tap after washing it.
quests.explanation: Rinse means to wash something with clean running water. We rinse the soap off our hands!
quests.funFact: Rinsing away soap and bubbles is the last step of washing up!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for rubbing something hard to make it very clean?
quests.question: Scrub
quests.hint: Think about rubbing a dirty pot very hard with a brush.
quests.explanation: Scrub means to rub something hard to make it very clean. We scrub a dirty pot!
quests.funFact: Scrubbing hard can clean away even the stickiest of messes!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for pulling the skin off a fruit or vegetable?
quests.question: Peel
quests.hint: Think about what you do to a banana before you eat it.
quests.explanation: Peel means to pull the outer skin off something, like a banana. We peel fruit before we eat it!
quests.funFact: Some fruit skins, like apple skin, are actually safe and healthy to eat too!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for mixing something round and round with a spoon?
quests.question: Stir
quests.hint: Think about moving a spoon in circles inside a bowl of soup.
quests.explanation: Stir means to mix something by moving a spoon around. We stir soup so it cooks evenly!
quests.funFact: Stirring helps mix ingredients together evenly when you cook!
